captions.detailed: This object is a ladder-frame three-branch fixture, featuring a dark grey or black narrow vertical ladder frame structure that acts as the main support. Mounted along the sides of this frame are three dark cheek blocks at different heights. Each block holds a light grey tapered stub arm. The three arms are designed as separate revolute joints, allowing independent rotation on their respective supports.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated three-branch fixture with a vertical ladder-frame support in dark grey, featuring three independent light-grey stub arms of varying lengths and heights mounted on cheek blocks. The arms should rotate independently as separate revolute joints.
captions.factory: Construct a vertical ladder frame using a union of box primitives for the side rails and cross rungs. Create three distinct cheek blocks as box shapes placed at offset vertical positions on the frame. Model the three stub arms using boxes with chamfered or tapered tips. Define the main frame as the base part, and define each arm as a separate part connected to the frame via revolute joints located at the centers of the cheek blocks.
